spans.s: उतथ्य m. N. of a son of Aṅgiras.
उतथ्यतनय m. the son of Utathya, i.e. Gautama.
उताहो v. उत.
उत्तंस m. crown, wreath of flowers.

उत्तंसय् उत्तस˚यति pp. उत्तंसित crown, adorn with
a wreath.
उत्तङ्क m. N. of a Ṛṣi.
उ॑त्तप्त a. heated, glowing, red-hot.

{#{{u/tTabDa->u/ttabDa||20160418|Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289|cf MW;
 alphabetical order}}#} a. erected, set up.
उत्तमजन m. pl. excellent people.
उत्तमतेजस् a. having excellent splendour or power.
उत्तमपुरुष m. the first person (g.), also = seq.
उत्तमपूरुष m. the supreme spirit.
उत्तमर्ण m. creditor.
उत्तम˚र्णिक m. creditor.
उत्तमवर्ण a. of beautiful colour or high caste.
उत्तमविद a. having the highest wisdom.
उत्तमसाहस m. the highest fine (j.).
उत्तमाङ्ग n. the head (lit. highest member).
उत्तमौजस् m. N. of a man (lit. of highest strength).

उत्तरा॑ adv. northward;
* north of (gen. or abl.).

उत्तार m. crossing, passing over (—˚);
 rescue, delivery.

उत्तरकाल m. future time;
 a. future, imminent.
उत्तरकुरु m. pl. the northern Kurus.
उत्तरकोसल m. the northern Kosalas.
1 उत्तरङ्ग m. a surging wave.
2 उत्तरङ्ग a. surging, heaving.
उत्तरङ्गिन् a. = prec.*
उत्तरणसेतु m. bridge to pass over (gen.).*
उत्तरदायक a. giving answer, contradicting.
उत्तरपद n. last member of a compound (g.).
उत्तर॑म् adv. further, later, hereafter.
उत्तरा॑म् adv. farther off.

उत्तरमीमांसा f. the latter part of the Mīmāṃsā,
i.e. the Vedānta.

उत्तररामचरित n. the further deeds of Rāma,
T. of a drama.

उत्तररामचरि˚त्र n. the further deeds of
Rāma, T. of a drama.

उत्तरल a. starting up, trembling;
 den. ˚लाय्, ˚यते.
उत्तरवेदि॑ f. the northern altar ((r.)).
उत्तरवे˚दी f. the northern altar ((r.)).
उत्तरा॑त् (abl. adv.) from the north or from the left.
उत्तरापथ m. the northern path, the north.

उत्तरायण n. the northern progress (of the sun), the
winter-solstice.
उत्तरारणि॑ f. the upper Araṇi (v. अर॑णि).

उत्तरार्थ a. taking place for the sake of what
follows.
उत्तरा॑वन्त् a. superior, victorious.
उत्तरासङ्ग m. उत्तरीय n. upper or outer garment.
उत्तरा॑हि adv. north (of — abl.*).

उ॑त्तरेण (instr. adv.) in the north or in the left side
(w. gen., abl., acc., or —˚).
उत्तरेद्यु॑स् adv. the next day.

उत्तरोत्तर a. following and following, later and
later, higher and higher, more and more. ˚— & n. adv.;
 n. as subst.
reply, talking, chattering.
उत्तरोत्तरोक्त a. always later mentioned.
उत्तरोष्ठ m. upper lip.
उत्त˚रौष्ठ m. upper lip.
उत्तानहृदय a. open-hearted.*
उत्तानी@कृ open wide.
